what_changed: The label table already on disk from the Analytics release lists 3,901 plays from the 2024 season with released coverage labels and no tracking. All 143 test-input plays are among them (108 zone, 35 man). Tracking from one release plus labels from the other give 143 labelled, never-examined 2024 plays.
how_to_describe_it: A small fresh-season sample: 142 plays reaching +1.5 s, 3 games, weeks 14, 15 and 18, one look. Same release format and the same post-play selection of tracked players. It is reported beside the 2023 benchmark (95.2%, previously examined), not in place of it.
still_blocked: Validation on a full unseen season, on different tracking, or on players not selected after the play. 3,758 labelled 2024 plays have no public tracking. This archive cannot supply more; do not request it again for that.
experimental_unscored_file: reports/v3/coverage_2024_unlabelled_experimental.json was written before the labels were joined and contains predictions only.
